pairs.question: Omnia quippe portenta contra naturam dicimus esse; sed non sunt. Quo modo est enim contra naturam, quod Dei fit uoluntate, cum uoluntas tanti utique conditoris conditae rei cuiusque natura sit?
pairs.answer: Portentum ergo fit non contra naturam, sed contra quam est nota natura.
pairs.derivation: Authorial self-question with its own answer introduced by 'ergo'. Question span widened back one sentence to 'Omnia quippe portenta contra naturam dicimus esse; sed non sunt.' so 'contra naturam' has its referent (self-containment); both sentences are contiguous in the source. Answer is the single 'Portentum ergo...' sentence (to the first full stop), which directly resolves the question; cut before the following 'Quis autem portentorum numerat multitudinem...' which turns to a new rhetorical question/digression. No words altered; only terminal punctuation is the source's own.
